events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect private stack, chain summary, and ports
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; ls /tmp/t242c/ | head -40; cat /tmp/t242c/chain/summary.txt | tail -40; for p in 8970 8972 8974; do echo "$p: $(lsof -ti:$p | head -2 | tr '\n' ' ')"; done; git diff --stat app/scripts/run-chain.sh

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check stack processes and chain scripts
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; for f in centre sim funnel runner chain walk; do p=$(cat /tmp/t242c/$f.pid 2>/dev/null); echo "$f $p $(ps -p $p -o comm= 2>/dev/null)"; done; for p in 8970 8972 8974; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "$p %{http_code}\n" --max-time 3 http://127.0.0.1:$p/; done; cat /tmp/t242c/chain-after-webinar.sh; cat /tmp/t242c/sim-reset.sh; git diff app/scripts/run-chain.sh

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find running sim, chain, and walker processes
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; ps -axo pid,etime,command | grep -E "vendor-sim|run-chain|walk-ui|walk-scen|http.server|4322" | grep -v grep | cut -c1-200; curl -s --max-time 3 -o /dev/null -w "4322 %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:4322/; grep -nE "timeout|walk|step\(\)|^step\(" app/scripts/run-chain.sh | head -30

events.name: Bash
events.head: Identify listener on sim port 8972
events.input: $ netstat -anv -p tcp 2>/dev/null | grep -E "\.(8972|8970|8974) .*LISTEN" | head; for p in 8142 32926 58962; do echo "$p $(ps -p $p -o command= | cut -c1-60) env:"; ps eww -p $p 2>/dev/null | tr ' ' '\n' | grep -E "SIM_PORT|SIM_STATE" ; done; tail -5 /tmp/t242c/sim.log
